protocol_amendment.reason: Independent V5 theory and red-team reviews found that the verifier could parse one file read and receipt a later read, admit unregistered curve-bit and B values before expensive reconstruction, execute row semantics after a known-invalid document envelope, advertise phases that did not execute, follow input-controlled replay caps, use a nondiscriminating duplicate-null fixture, and compare only partial standalone-B4 transcripts.
changes: Accept only the V6 document schema and reject every V1-V5 schema without row verification.

Open one no-follow regular file, read a maximum of 256 MiB once, and hash and parse the same immutable byte snapshot; reject changing metadata, directories, symlinks, malformed JSON, and duplicate keys before schema semantics.
Restrict JSON to 2000000 nodes, depth 64, and 8 MiB strings or keys.
Require an explicit registered direct-row scope and exact source-owned replay caps: 100000 nodes for the frozen fixture and 2000000 nodes for canonical rows.
Admit only B in {4,6,8}, the exact frozen curve or eight independently derived registered curve transcripts, the exact canonical grid and cap schedule, and a verifier primary budget in 0..5000000.
Fail after document or row digest, protocol, scope, grid, curve, cap, mask, type, or association errors before curve reconstruction, row semantics, replay, or proof.

Reserve separate trusted worst-case totals for registered curve draws, expansion cells, graph cells, replay nodes, primary nodes, both replay caches, both primary caches, retained-model calls, and retained-model cells before row semantics; reject an over-limit reservation.
Receipt actual replay nodes, proof nodes, replay-cache entries, a primary-cache upper bound, and document-local registered-curve cache entries separately from the worst-case reservation.
Emit an ordered actual-control-flow phase ledger and derive independent_checks only from completed phases.

Make the standalone frozen-B4 oracle derive p=19, a=2, b=9, q=23, B=4 and caps independently, then compare the complete factor-base, representative, rejection, conflict, graph, selected-mask, formal-family, constrained-label, edge, source-table, digest, axiom, and winner transcripts.

Use the discriminating duplicate-null multiset [8,8,10,12], whose registered median is 9 while a deduplicated median is 10; test strict 1/10 collapse, two versus three strata, and every-family collapse.
Keep every development family-row and canonical run budget at zero.
unchanged_mathematical_boundary: The curve grid, predicates, nulls, representative compiler, ordering digest, graph object, cap schedule, five-field objective, matched-null thresholds, positive gate, and negative classification remain unchanged.
Exactness remains finite and MODEL-BOUND to the fixed compiler and order-ideal construction.
No relation generation, rank, target descent, preprocessing crossover, rho comparison, exponent, deployment, or ECDLP result is in scope.
protocol_amendment.required_next_review: Fresh independent theory, accounting, and red-team review of one exact committed V6 snapshot. Three scoped GO decisions could authorize only a separate hash-complete launch-plan design, not execution.
